name: johnnyjansen.com
description: johnnyjansen.com: the static portfolio at the root plus the personal management portal (portal/ + functions/), one Firebase Hosting site.

scripts.build: npm run portal:build && npm run site:build && npm run functions:build
scripts.test:run: npm run portal:test && npm run functions:test
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run portal:build && npm run site:build && firebase deploy --only hosting
